title: RunPod GPU-fallback runs do not land an E5 result record (research/results/<unit>/<run_id>.jsonl)
note: Found by lane ML-DATA-OFF-TRAINER 2026-10-14. The router can now fall back class gpu -> runpod (auto_route: fallback; manifest requests only; ledger cap $10/month; dispatcher opens a gpu-burst-train issue). gpu-burst-train.yml has no step that writes the unit's result into research/results/, so a fallback run is fired and billed but its answer is not read by the collector. Fix: have the gpu-burst-train flow (or a post-step) land the E5 record, or make the fallback refuse until it does. Closes when a RunPod-run unit shows a landed result record. Until then the fallback only fires if GPU_BURST_ARMED is set (operator-armed), so exposure is bounded.
